description.narrative: Strategic Evaluations of Pacific and Development Group (PDG) programmes are intended to provide independent scrutiny and assessment of the International Development Cooperation's performance and identify lessons for improvement. Strategic Evaluations are conducted across areas of strategic importance for PDG to inform future planning for development effectiveness and impact, and to provide evidence for insights products across the International Development Cooperation programme.
